ECE 685 | Exam 1 Practice 2/42

Exam materials and conduct
Bring one student-prepared formula sheet. Attach it to your exam.
A non-programmable calculator is allowed and suggested for use.
Work independently. No communication or access to outside resources during
the exam.
Online students may use an authorized device only for remote proctoring or
submission.
ECE 685 | Exam 1 Practice 3/42

Answer format and grading
Multiple choice: select one answer per item. Each correct choice earns 4
points. No written explanation is required.
Calculations: show equations, substitutions, and units. Report numerical
results to three significant figures.
Use RMS phasors and positive 𝑎𝑏𝑐 sequence. Positive load 𝑃 , 𝑄 mean
absorption. Source power means power delivered to the loads.
Correct methods and consistent follow-through can earn partial credit.
Complete every section and reserve time to check signs, units, and per-unit bases.
ECE 685 | Exam 1 Practice 4/42

Practice topics
1. RMS phasors and complex power
2. Balanced three-phase circuits: line/phase quantities and delta–Y equivalence
3. Power-factor correction: single-phase method, then parallel three-phase loads
4. Transformer tests and referral: SC test; OC test
5. Per-unit calculations: base quantities, normalization, and base changes
6. Planning: screening cost and reserve margin
ECE 685 | Exam 1 Practice 5/42
